title: Code, results and pre-registration for: When can AI discover adsorption kinetics?
description: A pre-registered computational study of when equation-discovery methods recover the kinetic law of an adsorption column from its outlet and profile data. Ground truth comes from a verified finite-difference solver (imported from the Paper 1 archive, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23323685). Nine methods, three observation models and a grid of noise, Damkoehler and Peclet numbers are compared against profile-likelihood identifiability. The pre-registration (PREREG_P2_discoverability.md) and its amendments A1 to A4 were each committed before the runs they govern; the commit history is kept here.
